name: e2e-codecept
description: E2E tests for automationexercise.com powered by CodeceptJS and Playwright

scripts.test:ui: cross-env HEADLESS=true npx codeceptjs run --plugins allure --steps
scripts.test:headed: cross-env HEADLESS=false npx codeceptjs run --plugins allure --steps
scripts.test:smoke: cross-env HEADLESS=true npx codeceptjs run --plugins allure --steps --grep "@smoke"
scripts.test:smoke:headed: cross-env HEADLESS=false npx codeceptjs run --plugins allure --steps --grep "@smoke"
scripts.test:auth: cross-env HEADLESS=true npx codeceptjs run --plugins allure --steps --grep "@auth"
scripts.test:auth:headed: cross-env HEADLESS=false npx codeceptjs run --plugins allure --steps --grep "@auth"
scripts.test:regression: cross-env HEADLESS=true npx codeceptjs run --plugins allure --steps --grep "@regression"
scripts.test:regression:headed: cross-env HEADLESS=false npx codeceptjs run --plugins allure --steps --grep "@regression"

author: borbkin
